Swamp fever strikes the poorest people of Venore, and {npc:Ottokar}, at the city's asylum, fights it with pouches of medicine. While the fever spreads, {creature:Feverish Citizen|Feverish Citizens} appear around the city and may drop pieces of cloth for the {wiki:Afflicted Outfits Quest|Afflicted Outfits}. If you bring {item:Medicine Pouch|Medicine Pouches} to Ottokar, you receive bags with the belongings of the sick, which may contain {item:Slug Drug} to tame a mount.
Swamp fever, easy to treat, only affects the poorest of Venore, but the cure is nearby.

Pieces of cloth for the {wiki:Afflicted Outfits Quest} (from the Feverish Citizens)

The more Medicine Pouches the world hands in to Ottokar, the more rarely the Feverish Citizens appear. If you want the cloths for the Afflicted Outfits, it helps if the fever spreads; if you want Slug Drug, hand in pouches.

Go to the poorhouse in **Venore**. Leave through the **southwest** exit, walk **east** under the bridge and then **north** along the path. Talk to {npc:Ottokar} ({key:hi}): he tells you about his fight against the swamp fever.

While the fever is spreading, {creature:Feverish Citizen|Feverish Citizens} appear all over Venore and may attack you. The time between appearances can be 30 minutes or an hour or more, depending on the number of {item:Medicine Pouch|Medicine Pouches} handed in to Ottokar. When you kill them, they may drop pieces of cloth for the {wiki:Afflicted Outfits Quest}.
Getting to the Swamp Troll Cave
Leave **Venore** to the **south**, through the swamp, to the entrance of the {wiki:Swamp Troll Cave}, and go down.
Swamp Troll Cave entrance (south of Venore)

Alternative: the {wiki:Port Hope Swamp Trolls|Swamp Trolls of Port Hope}, **north** of Port Hope (boat: {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} with the port captain). Enter through one of the holes at {coord:32662,32742,7} or {coord:32678,32611,7}.
In the {wiki:Swamp Troll Cave}, kill {creature:Swamp Troll|Swamp Trolls} to get {item:Medicine Pouch|Medicine Pouches}. You can also go to the {wiki:Port Hope Swamp Trolls|Port Hope Swamp Trolls}.
To stop the fever from spreading, a certain number of pouches must be handed in to Ottokar **every day**.
Leaving the cave and returning to Venore

Leave the Swamp Troll Cave the same way you came in ({coord:32938,32219,7}) and head back **north**, through the swamp, to Venore and {npc:Ottokar}'s poorhouse. If you hunted in Port Hope, go up with the {item:Rope} through the hole you came down and take {npc:Charles}'s boat at the port: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}.
Go back to {npc:Ottokar} with the Medicine Pouches. In return you receive {item:Belongings of a Deceased|Belongings of a Deceased} (belongings of a deceased patient).
Open the {item:Belongings of a Deceased}. They can contain several things, including {item:Slug Drug}, which is used to tame wild {creature:Slug|Slugs} and get the {wiki:Tiger Slug} mount.
